scripts.setup: bun run setup:env && bun run setup:install
scripts.setup:env: cp -n .env.example .env || true && ln -sf ../.env schiphol-api/.env && ln -sf ../.env backend/.env && ln -sf ../.env frontend/.env
scripts.dev: docker compose --profile infra --profile app up -d && echo '[INFO] All services started.'
scripts.stop: docker compose --profile infra --profile app down && echo '[INFO] All services stopped.'
scripts.clean: docker compose --profile infra --profile app down -v && echo '[INFO] Environment cleaned (Volumes removed).'
